title: lld.v1 - the ONLY thing that crosses the orb->fleet seam (03 §6)
description: F02 lane contract §4.3: `lld.v1` used to denote four different shapes across the two blueprints and the code. It now denotes exactly one: this hand-off wrapper. `module_brief` is added beyond blueprint 03 §6's literal {freeze, sow_seed} pair (a named divergence, F02 §5.3) -- freeze.content_hash is the hash of the brief, and a consumer that receives only the freeze can never verify that hash; a self-verifying message is worth one extra field.
